articleTitle: Construction Methods, Data-Driven, and Operational Modes of Digital Twin Basin
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Digital twin basin is a combination of human-computer research and decision-making through the simulation, emulation, verification, prediction and deduction of the current physical basin behavior mechanism, state and rule of the digital space basin twin model composed of multiple unit objects of the basin. Aiming at the problems of basin mechanism rule data synthesis and data drive under the mechanism framework in the process of digital basin space basin twin model modeling, the research on the construction method and data drive of digital basin space basin twin model is systematically carried out, and the data drive mechanism based on the data thread and the data-driven model method under the mechanism framework are proposed; Finally, according to the construction method of digital twin basin, the operation mode of digital twin basin is proposed.

articleTitle: A YOLOv7 Forest Fire Detection System with Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Forest fires may cause serious human and economic losses, and it is also a key technology linked to realizing forest intelligent fire detection and prevention. Therefore, the study of forest fire detection and early warning system has great social application value. However, the traditional methods of detecting fires have weak real-time and detection capabilities. The new generation of deep learning technology, especially convolutional neural networks, provides new means and methods for fire detection. The convolutional neural network has the characteristics of good fault tolerance, self-adaptability, self-learning ability, and weight sharing, which makes the convolutional neural network can identify fires in a working principle close to that of the human eye. The fire detection method based on deep learning has high accuracy and robustness. However, due to its large number of parameters and a large number of calculations, it is difficult to be practically applied. With the development of edge computing, it is now possible to use the edge instead of the cloud for computing, which will greatly reduce latency. This paper collects a large number of forest fire images as a data set, trains a model that can recognize forest fires based on the YOLOv7 network, and further deploys the trained model to the edge server RK3588. Finally, a front-end visual interface capable of displaying fire recognition results was built using Pyqt5. The model in this method has good robustness and generalization ability, and the application of edge computing in fire forest detection further improves the speed of fire detection, which provides a new way for forest fire detection.

articleTitle: t-SNE Based on Halton Sequence Initialized Butterfly Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE), as a type of dimensionality reduction algorithm, is usually used to visualize and explore high-dimensional data. By comparing with other dimensionality reduction algorithms, t-SNE has the best effect for data visualization. If it is applied to n-dimensional data, intelligent mapping can be successfully done from n-dimensional data to 3-dimensional data, or even 2-dimensional data, and the probability distribution of the original data can be properly kept even after the dimensionality reduction process. t-SNE is not a linear dimensionality reduction technique, and it is good at processing nonlinear structural data, thus, it is easy for t-SNE algorithm to obtain complex manifold structures from high-dimensional data. Usually, t-SNE does not have a unique optimal solution, and the number of iterations and the convergence of its objective function are the main factors which can affect its visualization effect. Generally, gradient descent (GD) method is used to solve the problem of minimum Kullback-Leiber (KL) divergence of the objective function. However, due to the disadvantage of GD method that can easily fall into local optimal value, in this paper, Halton sequence initialized butterfly optimization algorithm (HSBOA) has been combined with traditional t-SNE algorithm so as to improve the optimization accuracy and convergence speed, and to effectively help t-SNE jump out of the local optimal value trap during the optimization process.

articleTitle: Map-less End-to-end Navigation of Mobile Robots via Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: A deep reinforcement learning model with a unique long-term memory capability is proposed in this paper, which addresses the map-less navigation of mobile robots in dynamic environments. Based on the recurrent neural network, the proposed model takes continuous historical states as input and better handles dynamic obstacles. Furthermore, a novel reward function is designed to ensure smooth navigation trajectories and satisfactory navigation results in dynamic environments. The proposed approach is evaluated on the Gazebo simulation platform, and higher navigation success rates in dynamic environments are achieved.

articleTitle: Backstepping Sliding Mode Control for Quadrotor UAV Based on Adaptive Observer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper considers the accurate trajectory control of quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) under the presence of both actuator faults and uncertain disturbances. A new approach that combines an adaptive observer with a backstepping sliding mode control method is proposed. The proposed adaptive observer is designed to accurately observe and compensate for the uncertain faults and external disturbances in a quadrotor system. Stability analysis shows that the error of trajectory control by the proposed controller is guaranteed to converge to zero when both actuator faults and uncertain disturbances are present in a quadrotor system. Simulation results show that the proposed controller can achieve performance better than that of a few other control methods for the trajectory control of quadrotor UAVs under the presence of both actuator faults and uncertain disturbances.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Oriented Virtual View Rendering Algorithm Based on K-means
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The Depth Image Based Rendering (DIBR) is an important visual simulation method in digital twin, which can be used to generate virtual viewpoints of physical objects, enabling visualization and manipulation of physical objects. DIBR technique can quickly and effectively synthesize virtual viewpoint images. However, the problem of overlapping in the synthesized images seriously affects the quality of the views. To address the overlapping problem in virtual viewpoint images based on binocular fusion, a K-means based layered image virtual viewpoint rendering algorithm is proposed. Most of the existing layered algorithms use the Canny operator to distinguish between foreground and background, which requires manually setting the segmentation threshold. In this paper, a layered mapping drawing method based on K-means is designed to automatically and accurately distinguish between foreground and background. The layered mapping is used to avoid mutual interference between foreground and background pixels. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively solve the problem of overlapping in virtual viewpoint rendering, and has better performance in PSNR and SSIM compared to other algorithms.

articleTitle: A Classification Method Based on CNN-BiLSTM for Difficult Detecting DGA Domain Name
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm) domain name detection is one of hot topics in cyber security, as DGA domain names are constantly updated to improve concealability. Characteristics of DGA domain names become more implicit and complex, so the detection effect of traditional deep learning models on some DGA domain names is not well. This paper studied characteristics of DGA domain name and proposed a detection model based on CNN and BiLSTM, which could extract local phrase features and bidirectional global dependence features from multiple dimensions. Experimental results show that CNN-BiLSTM model proposed in this paper can significantly improve the detection effect of wordlist-based DGA domain name, shorter-length DGA domain name, and small-member DGA domain name both in two-classification and multi-classification. In two-classification, the performance of CNN-BiLSTM model was the best, precision reached 93.11%, recall reached 95.95%, and F1 score reached 94.51%. Evaluation indexes of CNN-BiLSTM model were around 3% higher than the other two models. In multi-classification, precision reached 91.02%, recall reached 92.33%, and F1 score reached 91.57%. They were about 2.5% higher than BiLSTM model and much higher than CNN model. Moreover, CNN-BiLSTM model could detect more DGA families.

articleTitle: Short Text Sentiment Analysis Based on Multiple Attention Mechanisms and TextCNN-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Researchers have been paying more and more attention lately to the use of natural language processing methods to analyze the sentiment of short text. Due to the characteristics of sparsity and irregularity, short text classification often has a large number of implied semantics, which requires a high feature learning ability of the model. The current common models, like Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), can extract the local information of sentences but ignore the contextual semantic information between words. Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory Network (BiLSTM) can fill in the deficiencies left by CNN's inability to effectively extract the contextual semantic information of text, but the local features of sentences cannot be extracted well. In this paper, a text sentiment analysis classification model based on multiple attention mechanisms and TextCNN-BiLSTM is proposed. The dynamic word vector representation of text is obtained by the BERT model, local information with different granularity is extracted in parallel by TextCNN with different scales, The global dependence is then mined using the multi-head self-attention process, which reduces the impact of context-dependent long-distance words. To obtain the prediction result of sentiment analysis, the BiLSTM model is finally input to fuse the time sequence information, the attention mechanism is combined to focus on the crucial data. The experimental results show that the accuracy and F1 are improved on two data sets compared with previously reported models.

articleTitle: A Formal Analysis of Emergency Communication System Based on Model Checking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Emergency communication system is utilized widely to serve professional mobile communication for public security. Strict inspections must be conducted to ensure the system's high reliability, as inherent protocol complexities and design flaws may cause logical vulnerabilities in protocol implementation. In this paper, we investigate the security of the emergency communication, taking the TETRA system as an example. Specifically, we analyze two critical procedures (i.e., registration and call control) of the TETRA system. As a result, we uncover several potential flaws in the system. Furthermore, to expose vulnerabilities, we apply model checking to the automatic analysis of the TETRA system using the tool NuSMV. At last, we verified our findings in the real TETRA testbed environment. The results show that the attacks can induce service disruption, and the proposed method is feasible to TETRA system analysis.

articleTitle: ConceptĶ Technology Features and System Architecture of Industrial Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: As a new virtual shared space after the Internet, the metaverse aims to explore the relationship between humans and a new virtual space using a combination of digital technologies. It promotes technological innovation and economic and social development by providing a new space for interaction between humans and the digital world. Industrial metaverse integrates real-world industrial physical scenes with virtual digital spaces to create a visual overlay environment that achieves “virtual reality” collaboration across the product life cycle, driving optimization of industrial processes and improving efficiency. This paper proposes the basic concepts, technical features, and system architecture of industrial metaverse from the perspective of new information and communication technologies (ICT), Finally, the paper identifies the challenges that industrial metaverse faces.

articleTitle: Gastric Endoscopy Image Classification Based on MobileSiT-SimAM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Gastric endoscopy image classification is an important task for the diagnosis and treatment of gastrointestinal diseases. However, existing methods based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) or vision transformers (ViTs) have some limitations, such as insufficient feature extraction, fixed receptive field, or high computational cost. In this paper, we propose a novel method based on MobileSiT-SimAM, which integrates a lightweight ViT model (MobileSiT) and a self-adaptive attention mechanism (SimAM). MobileSiT adopts a hierarchical structure and a shifted window partitioning scheme to achieve information sharing across layers and dynamic receptive fields. SimAM can filter and weight the feature maps, enhance task-relevant features and suppress task-irrelevant features, and improve the performance of the CNN model without increasing the number of parameters. We conduct experiments on the processed Kvasir dataset, the results show that our method achieves 98.57% accuracy, which outperforms several state-of-the-art models, such as VGGNet, MobileNetV3, GoogleNet, MobileViT, and ResNet. Our method also demonstrates robustness to different image sizes and noise levels. Therefore, our method can provide an effective and efficient solution for gastric endoscopy image classification.

articleTitle: Optimize Linear Antenna Arrays with Dandelion Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the application of dandelion optimization (DO) algorithm in linear antenna arrays. This is the first time that DO has been used in the optimization of antenna arrays. DO is a new type of evolutionary algorithm inspired by nature, inspired by dandelions' wind-borne behavior in nature. The algorithm iteratively updates the population from three stages: ascending, descending and landing, and finally finds the optimal position. DO can be used to optimize linear antenna arrays to get the antenna pattern geometry we need. In this work, we use the following methods to conduct research experiments: by controling the antenna array element spacing and phase unchanged to optimize the current amplitude for an array pattern with minimum side lobe level (SLL). To demonstrate how DO can be used for linear array optimization, two examples are given. In terms of suppressing peak SLL in comparison with nonoptimized and other known metaheuristic optimization techniques. The optimization ability of DO is better than them. This demonstrates the feasibility of the DO algorithm for optimizing antenna arrays and even other problems in electromagnetism.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Based Cross Domain Authentication Scheme in Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: At present, a large number of independent Internet of Things (IoT) systems are constructed, resulting in the phenomenon of data islands. In the future, the IoT will urgently require efficient collaboration between independent IoT terminals and systems to meet the increasing and diversified IoT needs. However, in the process of the integration of blockchain and identity authentication mechanism, there are problems such as difficult unification of cross-domain identity trust mapping and low efficiency of authentication service. A cross-domain identity trust authentication scheme for the IoT is proposed by us. We integrate edge computing and blockchain, introduce side chain technology to construct master-slave chain, propose and improve Identity-Based Cryptograph (IBC) mechanism under cross-domain trusted architecture, and design cross-domain trusted authentication architecture. The analysis and evaluation show that this scheme implements the trusted mapping between data on the blockchain, improves the efficiency of cross-domain terminal authentication.

articleTitle: A Routing Algorithm for High-Speed Mobile Ad Hoc Network Based on Deep Q Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, a high-speed Mobile Ad Hoc Network (MANET) routing algorithm based on Deep Q Network (DQN) is proposed. The routing decision problem is modeled as a Markov Decision Process (MDP). The current node id with packets and the distance from the destination node are taken as the input state. The reward function is designed considering the neighbor nodes' number, the remaining capacity of the link and the relative speed between the current node and the next node. DQN is used to determine the next hop for data transmission. Simulation results show that compared with AODV, the proposed algorithm reduces the communication delay by 75% and increases the data arrival rate by 15%. Compared with Q-Routing, the communication delay and data arrival rate of this algorithm are more stable in the network where nodes move at high speed. The algorithm can adjust the routing decision in time when network topology changes and improve the stability of the network.

articleTitle: Measurement Automation Terminal Security Assessment Based on Bayes Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In the increasingly complex environment of the power network, the metering automation terminals of the power system face more and more security threats. The stability of the power system is based on the safety of the metering automation terminal, but the assessment of the safety risk of the metering automation terminal has the problems of difficulty in determining the indicators and low accuracy of the evaluation results. To improve the accuracy and effectiveness of the security assessment of the measurement automation terminal, this paper establishes a security assessment index system for the measurement automation terminal and effectively evaluates the terminal. Firstly, the terminal security evaluation index system is established from the three aspects of hardware, application, and network. Secondly, based on the weights of the evaluation indicators qualitatively analyzed by the AHP method, the judgment matrix is checked by the consistency analysis, and the subjective weights of the risk evaluation indicators are obtained. Then, the index weight is dynamically adjusted through the Bayesian prior probability property to obtain the objective weight of the evaluation index, and the comprehensive weight is calculated through the combined weighting to realize the monitoring and evaluation of the measurement automation terminal behavior. Finally, the simulation experiments are carried out. The results show that the security goal of the power metering automation system depends to a large extent on the hardware environment and application security.

articleTitle: Chipless Wireless Temperature Sensor Based on BST Thin Film
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper presents a chipless Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tag with temperature sensing, which combines the structure of a square ring and a V-shaped antenna to reduce the tag size while increasing the resonance point. The tag uses polyvinyl chloride (PVC) as a substrate. The feasibility of the sensor operating at 2.4 GHz frequency is verified by integrating the temperature sensitive material barium-strontium-titanate (BST), which is a ferroelectric material and shows a positive correlation between its Relative permittivity and the ambient temperature. The Radar Cross section(RCS) increases linearly as the ambient temperature increases from 20°C to 80°C, with an average sensitivity of 8.3°C/dB. The sensor tag is wireless, passive, low cost, and miniaturized, and has excellent potential for various applications.

articleTitle: A Non-Contact Human-Computer Interaction Method Based on Gaze
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Gaze interaction has a broad application prospect in the field of human-computer interaction. Traditional gaze interactive sensing devices are expensive and inconvenient to use. The gaze point estimation model based on deep learning is complex and poor in generalization, and difficult to deploy on intelligent terminals. This paper proposed a gaze point estimation network based on deep learning and its personalized calibration method which can adapt to different devices and users. The gaze point estimation network used eye images, eye corners and the camera relative to screen position as inputs to extract feature embeddings. Then the feature embeddings were fed to the trained personalized SVR model to obtain the final gaze point estimation. Tests were conducted on both the self-built gaze dataset and the open source dataset to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model in terms of accuracy and latency. On this basis, a simple human-computer interaction application was implemented by analyzing the fixation point and identifying the user's control behavior.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-based Method for Monitoring User-plane Congestion in Mobile Core Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Nowadays, 5G NPN network is flourishing and the scale of PLMN is gradually expanding, that leading to the emergence of numerous demand and scenarios for cross-network communication among multiple operators. In this paper, we focus on the issues of delay feedback, and congestion monitoring for cross-network communication. Specifically, we investigate the forwarding unit UPF in 5G mobile communication core network and propose a monitoring method based on blockchain. We employ blockchain to save ledger data, ensuring the traceability of packet forwarding latency. By utilizing MPT, we can reduce the storage burden of the blockchain, we also analyze the storage cost of introducing this trust mechanism locally on UPF. A 5G core network prototype system is implemented to validate the feasibility of this method. It can detect congested nodes and paths in the system with the precise timing and synchronization.

articleTitle: Design of a Communication Base Station Monitoring System Based on RCS in Smart City Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the arrival of 5G era and the vigorous development and construction of smart city infrastructure, the coverage of a single base station becomes smaller, so it needs to be covered by a dense base station. As the infrastructure of wireless communication, communication base station plays an important role in the communication process. At present, for the monitoring of the environment of the communication base station room, the patrol personnel are mainly on duty, which is a waste of manpower and a high cost of personnel. This paper proposes a design method of communication base station monitoring system based on RCS technology. Using RCS fusion communication technology, through the three-level architecture of sensing terminal, edge gateway and monitoring center, the alarm data is collected, analyzed and processed by the edge gateway through RCS information, and then reported to the monitoring center and the processing information is distributed to the base station patrol personnel in real time. The terminal can still receive the alarm information in the form of short message when it is not connected to the network, so that the user can know the dangerous situation monitored by the monitoring system in time and improve the monitoring effect.

articleTitle: Blockchain with Machine Learning for Financial Portfolio Management
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Portfolio management diversifies investment across multiple assets for increased return and reduced risks. In the decentralized world of Web3, financial management companies are increasingly investing in blockchain ledger systems for asset transactions. As a result, new models of portfolio trading are needed. The paper presents a prototype of a portfolio management system with a machine learning-enabled recommend subsystem. The proposed account role mechanism combines user-defined functions and automated asset management operations. The combination of blockchain and artificial intelligence enables smart portfolio management.

articleTitle: Distributed Database Design and Performance Tuing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: it is necessary to design a distributed database for real-time data storage to meet the needs of rapid data collection, for the operation and maintenance of large and complex systems. The system adopts the distributed database integrated with three databases to meet the storage of different types of data such as structured data and time series data of the operation and maintenance system. Based on the characteristics of data collection, the system adopts three methods: horizontal database partitioning, horizontal table partitioning, and horizontal partitioning to reduce the amount of table data and meet the performance requirements of the system.

articleTitle: Intelligent Condition Monitoring and Fault Diagnosis of Generator based on Internet of Things and Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Main generator is a major and critical equipment in nuclear power plant. Condition monitoring and fault diagnosis of generator is the prerequisite for accurately grasping the health status and trending, exactly recognizing potential defects and scientific decision-making, which is significant for ensuring the safety and reliability of both generator and the nuclear power unit. Taking certain main generator as an example, this paper studied and formulated corresponding technical solution for realizing an integrated intelligent platform for parameters monitoring, comprehensive analysis, intelligent monitoring and fault diagnosis, and expounded relevant core technologies in parameters integration based on internet of things, and intelligent monitoring and fault diagnosis based on big data and expert knowledge database, and introduced the development and demonstration of this system in field. This system provides a reference for other nuclear power plants and other important equipment to carry out advanced monitoring and diagnosis application.

articleTitle: Optimal Pattern Synthesis of Linear Antenna Array Using Wild Horse Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to introduce the Wild Horse Optimizer (WHO) algorithm to the electromagnetics and antenna community. WHO algorithm is a new nature-inspired algorithm mimicking the social behavior of wild horses in nature. One of the advantages of WHO is that it has only a few parameters to be optimized, making it a flexible algorithm to solve various problems. In this paper, we present an optimization technique that can improve the currents of an antenna array. WHO algorithm was used in this paper to optimize antenna array currents in order to design linear antenna array models. This study presents several design experiments to demonstrate the utility of WHO in optimizing linear arrays to achieve lowest side lobe level and zero positions in specified directions. Compare the results with other natural heuristic meta-heuristic algorithms such as particle swarm optimization (PSO), grey wolf optimization (GWO) and biogeography based optimization (BBO). The results show that optimizing linear antenna arrays using WHO provides significant improvements over arrays obtained from other optimization techniques.

articleTitle: The Research of Chinese Text Proofreading base on Pattern Matching
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Chinese automatic proofreading of text is one of the main applications of natural language processing and a difficult problem for natural language understanding. Aiming at the errors caused by local or long-distance syntax or semantic constraints, this paper proposes a text proofreading method based on pattern matching. This method uses the characteristics of Chinese grammatical structure and semantic limitations to construct recognition pattern that integrates grammatical structure and conditional restrictions, and uses the defined pattern to match the sentences to be checked for error checking and error correction. Experiments show that the recall of the method reaches 95%, the accuracy reaches 90%, and the method has certain practicality.

articleTitle: A Fault Management Window Algorithm Based on Dynamic Fault Information Feedback in MCVideo System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For the problem that the intelligent fault management method leads to a large load on the MCVideo system server and poor fault management effect, a fault management window algorithm based on dynamic fault information feedback in MCVideo system is proposed. Firstly, a phased indicator monitoring method and a reference indicator update method are established. Then, the phased indicator monitoring method is used to obtain system data and calculate the phased indicators and the fault management window algorithm is used to assign a new fault management window for the fault management in the next stage. Finally, the reference indicator update method is used to obtain the updated reference indicators to realize the dynamic fault management in MCVideo system. The verification results show that the comprehensive fault management effect of the algorithm proposed in this paper is better than that of the traditional fault management window algorithms, because low cumulative fault processing delay and low fault management overhead have been obtained in the algorithm proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Lymph Node Ultrasound Image Segmentation Algorithm Based on Multimodal Image Fusion and DMA-UNet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Lymph nodes are important peripheral immune organs in the human immune system, and a variety of systemic and restrictive diseases can attack lymph nodes, leading to changes in their morphology and structure. Accurate identification of lymph nodes is of great value for the diagnosis, treatment and subsequent evaluation of lymph node diseases. The article firstly proposes a multimodal image fusion method for image preprocessing based on the characteristics of lymph node ultrasound images, and then proposes DMA-UNet based on the UNet network model, which uses residual convolution blocks and multiscale dilated convolution blocks instead of the original single <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{3} \ast\mathbf{3}$</tex> convolution in the codec structure, enabling the nodes of different sizes to be treated during feature extraction. Meanwhile, a hybrid attention mechanism is used in the jump-long connection path of the UNet network model, which solves the problem that the decoding layer will introduce useless noise and other information besides the detailed features of lymph nodes, and achieves better nodal segmentation results.

articleTitle: A Highly Trustworthy Fusion Localization Method Based on Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: To achieve highly trusted wide-area wireless localization, the on-demand access to multi-source information becomes critical. However, the current means of fusing multi-source heterogeneous information for localization is single, and the selection of weight space often relies on experience. To this end, this paper proposes a hierarchical confidence evaluation method for multi-source information, using Euclidean distance as the objective to optimize the confidence probability of spatial fusion of each localization algorithm, using Dempster combination rules to synthetically assign confidence to the basic information from different moments. In this way, a confidence evaluation model of multi-source information is constructed, and the final confidence results are obtained by the hierarchical fusion of two layers of confidence functions. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively fuse the localization results of RSSI fingerprint matching, Kalman filter and LLOP closed-form algorithms, and the algorithm in this paper has stronger environmental adaptability and robustness compared with fixed weight fusion.

articleTitle: Distributed Formation Control for Multiple Spacecraft with Event-triggered Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper discusses a distributed formation control for multiple spacecraft system under the directed communication topology. By considering only a portion of the follower access to the leader's information, a distributed estimator and an adaptive control law are proposed to account for parametric uncertainties and the leader's constant velocity. To reduce the communication cost, the event-triggered strategy is provided. Then, it is proved through Lyapunov analyses that the multiple spacecraft can achieve the expected configuration and all follower can track the dynamic leader. Meanwhile, the Zeno behavior can avoid. Finally, the numerical simulation is carried out to verify the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Segmented Fast Capture Algorithm Based on Combined Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For the situation that the combined localization signal reception in Time and Code division-orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing(TC-OFDM) system of terrestrial communication network needs to be captured quickly, the segmented fast capture algorithm based on combined signal is proposed to reduce the capture time by splitting the process of signal into stages and then introducing the matching library with the first stage index information to reduce the search domain in the second stage. After simulation experiments, it is proved that in the presence of communication interference and white noise interference, the capture speed can be improved by 35.44% using the algorithm proposed in this paper compared with the Partial Matched Filter-Fast Fourier Transform(PMF-FFT) algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Rule Mining Method for Incremental Small Sample Experimental Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In terms of fault diagnosis and prediction, new equipment mainly has the characteristics of small data samples and increasing sample size. In the rulemaking process, there are problems such as incomplete data, insufficient rules support, low accuracy data and information completeness, the current method is difficult to automatically correct forward rules based on continuously accumulated data. There is a lack of basic models and algorithms for rule correction, This method establishes an initial rule library after modeling system faults based on knowledge and data fusion. When a system fault occurs, it will exhibit various abnormal phenomena, and the collection of different types of abnormal phenomena (i.e. fault phenomena) corresponds to typical faults.

articleTitle: Linear Array Synthesis Using Sea-horse Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, Sea-horse optimization (SHO) algorithm is proposed to optimize the excitation amplitude of linear array antenna to get desired array pattern. The SHO algorithm is inspired by the movement, predation and reproduction behavior of the seahorse. It is a high-performance evolutionary algorithm that can solve high dimensional, linear and nonlinear problems. The SHO algorithm is used to determine the amplitude of a set of optimal uniform linear array elements. Two examples are designed in the text. First, the SHO algorithm is optimized the peak sidelobe level (PSLL) in specific region, and compares it with the BBO algorithm. Then, the SHO algorithm is optimized the PSLL in a specific region while pulling down the first sidelobe level (first SLL), and compares it with the BBO algorithm. The above two examples verify the feasibility of the SHO algorithm in antenna.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of VDES Data Gateway Applied to Maritime Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to realize and expand the data exchange function of VDES, the VDES data gateway for maritime communication is designed according to the VDES standard and the data transmission characteristics of the VDES system. VDES data gateway can realize the functions including resource management and allocation, packet data filtering and packet data forwarding in ship-to-shore communication. The VDES data gateway is developed on the Linux platform, and the VDES testing environment is built. The functions of VDES data gateway is verified, which provides reference for the development and application of VDES system.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Generation Technology of Earthquake Emergency Thematic Map Based on MapWorld API
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Earthquake emergency thematic maps play an important role in post-earthquake emergency work. The generation process of earthquake emergency thematic map requires high timeliness and stability. Traditional manual generating methods are often difficult to meet the actual application requirements. In this paper, an automatic and rapid generation technology of emergency thematic map using MapWorld API is proposed and implemented. The key technologies, system design, implementation results and practical application are discussed. We realize the software in Visual Studio 2018, and apply it to actual earthquake emergency work. The research results show that the generation of earthquake emergency thematic map based on MapWorld API is fast and convenient, without considering about data source and commercial GIS software, and has important practical significance.

articleTitle: Research on the Integrated Earthquake Network Monitoring and Management Platform in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Earthquake network is the most important infrastructure in earthquake prevention and disaster reduction work, which can provide monitoring data support for earthquake prediction, earthquake emergency response, and related scientific research. Therefore, how to scientifically and effectively manage earthquake networks is an important research issue for earthquake prevention and disaster reduction. This paper takes the Beijing region as an example to implement an integrated earthquake network monitoring and management platform. The core functions of the system include: site visualization management, equipment status management, business data management, operation and maintenance duty management, user permission management, and so on. Based on this platform, the full process visualization management of earthquake network has been achieved, greatly improving the quality of operation and maintenance and the level of data management, which has positive significance in practical work.

articleTitle: Edge Computing Resource Management Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Resource management in edge computing has always been a hot research topic. In the scenario of multiple edge servers and multiple tasks, this paper proposes a task offloading model that optimizes the total cost by weighting energy consumption and latency to reduce energy consumption and latency. Based on the proposed task offloading model, an improved genetic algorithm is proposed to solve the optimal task offloading strategy. Simulation experiments have shown that applying improved genetic algorithms to task offloading models can accelerate convergence speed, find the optimal computing offloading strategy, and improve system performance.

articleTitle: Advanced Monitoring Infrastructure System Architecture for Massive Multi-Source Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Advanced metering infrastructure(AMI) is an important part of the smart grid, mainly consisting of metering terminals for data collection and master systems for data analysis. With the continuous development of smart grid, the number of metering terminals is increasing significantly, and the terminal data to be processed will grow exponentially, putting higher requirements on the performance of AMI system data processing. Meanwhile, the security and reliability of the system cannot be guaranteed due to the lack of monitoring of terminal status and real-time perception of network segment traffic, and the establishment of the system security defense system is still in its initial stage. To meet the demand for real-time processing of massive data, realize the rapid transformation of multi-source, multi-location, and multi-temporal data, and guarantee the safe and stable operation of AMI, this paper proposes an AMI monitoring system architecture for massive multi-source data, which uses deep packet detection technology and clustering methods to filter and statistic the data stream. Combined with the microservice technology to build a security monitoring platform, it solves the problem of rapid extraction, analysis, and storage of massive data, and realizes the monitoring of terminal behavior status and real-time perception of network segment traffic situations.

articleTitle: Attention-based BiLSTM Model for Rainfall Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to further improve the accuracy of rainfall prediction, this paper proposes a Bi-LSTM prediction model incorporating an attention mechanism. The model splits the input sequence into a spatio-temporal sequence and a feature sequence, and introduces an attention mechanism before the Bi-LSTM network model to calculate the attention of the two sequences separately before fusion. The Bi-LSTM network can adaptively select the most important input features according to their importance, and the parameters of the attention layer are obtained by a competitive random search algorithm, which further enhances the robustness of the model. Finally, the prediction experiments are conducted on real data, and the results show that the Bi-LSTM model based on attention mechanism has better prediction accuracy compared with support vector regression (SVR) and LSTM models, which can provide technical support for precipitation prediction.

articleTitle: Lightweight and Data-imbalance-aware Defect Detection Approach Based on Federated Learning in Industrial Edge Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Accurate and timely defect detection in industrial edge networks is becoming increasingly important in intelligent manufacturing. However, the privacy concern and limited resources of edge devices hinder the applications of existing defect detection models. This paper presents a new defect detection approach based on federated learning (FL), where the transmission of privacy-sensitive data can be avoided and user privacy and data security can be well preserved. We first propose a lightweight defect detection model based on YOLOv5s. We use ShuffleNet as the backbone of YOLOv5s, use the SE attention mechanism and LRELU to improve the learning accuracy. We then develop a clustering-based device selection approach to address the degradation of accuracy caused by imbalanced data distributions of devices in FL. Corroborated by simulations, the accuracy of the proposed defect detection model increases by 26.86% as compared with existing models, and the proposed device selection approach is also superior to the benchmarks in terms of learning accuracy.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Band Selection Based on Fuzzy C-means and Dingo Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Dimensionality reduction is necessary for hyperspectral image processing to reduce redundant information and improve classification accuracy and efficiency. Band selection is a dimensionality reduction method that selects a representative subset of bands from a hyperspectral band set according to certain rules. A novel band selection method based on fuzzy c-means (FCM) and dingo optimization algorithm (DOA) is proposed, which uses the FCM Algorithm to divide hyperspectral image into several subspaces and then uses the DOA to select representative bands within each subspace. The objective function of the optimization algorithm integrates the band information entropy and the redundancy of the band subsets. Three commonly used hyperspectral image datasets were used to test the proposed algorithm, and support vector machine was used to classify the selected bands. The results have shown that the proposed algorithm has high classification accuracy compared with other algorithms, which verifies the effectiveness of band selection.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Oriented Virtual Viewpoint Rendering Algorithm Based on Layered Image Mapping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Virtual viewpoint synthesis technology can provide a more realistic appearance and perspective for digital twins. The most widely implemented method in virtual viewpoint synthesis technology is Depth Image Based Rendering (DIBR) technology, where depth maps reflect the depth information of objects in the scene. We propose a virtual viewpoint rendering algorithm based on layered image mapping to address the issues of overlap and artifacts in virtual views. According to the idea of layered mapping, the overlapping phenomenon caused by the mismapping of background pixels to the foreground region in the process of spatial mapping is avoided. We use dual viewpoint complementarity to fill holes in the left and right virtual viewpoint foreground, and then fuse them with their respective backgrounds within the frame to avoid overlapping holes filled by background pixels and interference between the front and background pixels.

articleTitle: Dynamic Traffic Limiting Algorithm Based on Token Bucket for Distributed Digital Trunk
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low success rate of receiving requests, large response delay and low throughput in multi-user and high-concurrency scenarios, a dynamic traffic limiting algorithm based on token bucket for distributed digital trunk is proposed to optimize the high concurrency, high availability and high performance of the distributed digital trunk system. Firstly, the token bucket with a fixed number of tokens is initialized, the maximum capacity of the token bucket and the rate of token addition are set. Secondly, the load index of each server of the system is established and collected. Then the total load of the system is obtained by the dynamic traffic limiting algorithm. Finally, the token addition rate is dynamically adjusted based on the total system load. The simulation results show that compared with blank group, traditional traffic limiting algorithm and other dynamic traffic limiting algorithm, the proposed algorithm is more effective in increasing the success rate of receiving requests, reducing the average response delay and improving the system throughput.

articleTitle: QoS Assessment of Root DNS Servers Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The root DNS (Domain Name System) server is top-level node of DNS and an important infrastructure of the Internet. The stable operation of the root DNS server is of great significance to cyber security and keeping development of the digital economy. This paper mainly studied the measurement and assessment of root DNS servers. First, factors that affect service quality were analyzed, and loss rate, resolution success rate, resolution delay, critical path length were choosen as key indicators. Because it was difficult to obtain the resolution log, active detection nodes which were distributed in 31 provinces were used to collect data. Then based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, a QoS (quality of service) assessment model of root DNS servers was proposed. Finally, 13 root DNS servers around the world were evaluated. Assessment results show that QoS of different root DNS servers varies greatly. For some root DNS servers, such as B-root and C-root, there is still ample room for improvement. Furthermore, QoS of root DNS servers can be effectively improved by introducing root instances, which provides support for the introduction of root instances in China.

articleTitle: An Edge-Guided Weighted Image Interpolation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For the problem of poor performance of linear image interpolation and high complexity of nonlinear image interpolation, an edge-guided weighted image interpolation algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the edge feature of the low-resolution image is detected by the Sobel operator, and the edge strength and direction of the high-resolution image are calculated by the bilinear interpolation algorithm. Then, the warped distance of the reference pixels and weighted Lanczos kernel are calculated by the edge features of the high-resolution image. Finally, the reference pixels are weighted to obtain the resulting high-resolution image. The simulation results show that the proposed interpolation algorithm is more accurate than traditional interpolation algorithms, and the computing time of the upscaling by a factor of 2 for the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{256}\times \mathbf{256}$</tex> image with the proposed algorithm is less than 50ms, which is attractive for real-time communication and image applications.

articleTitle: Improvement on Knowledge-grounded Dialogue Generation with Continuous Prompt Tuning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, a two-stage knowledge-grounded dialogue generation framework is proposed, which addresses the problem of generic and uninformative dialogue generation. An integrated system of continuous prompt tuning and response selection is introduced, which effectively filters out invalid results and improves the quality of the generated answers. The number of training parameters is significantly reduced by our training method, making it more efficient compared to existing models. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on a recently proposed dialogue dataset using various metrics.

articleTitle: A Static Letter Sign Language Recognition Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This article presents an improved static sign language recognition algorithm based on the YOLOv5 network model. The algorithm utilizes SimAM attention module and ASFF adaptive feature fusion module to optimize the original model and enhance its capacity for both feature extraction and target recognition. Experimental outcomes demonstrate that the enhanced model achieves a remarkable mAP increase of 3.7 percentage points while maintaining the same level of inference speed, manifesting an impressive level of effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Multiparty Participation Collaborative Supervision Strategy of AIGC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The emergence and popularity of ChatGPT has sparked a new wave of “artificial intelligence” worldwide. AIGC is a true industrial revolution-level artificial intelligence technology revolution that will bring significant changes to the entire country, the world, and humanity. Like all technologies, the development of AIGC technology not only brings convenience and innovation to people, but also brings many risks and challenges. By studying the principle of AIGC technology and combining with typical cases, this paper analyzes the causes of security problems caused by the model defects and abuse propagation, focusing on the analysis of privacy Data breach, prejudice and discrimination, copyright disputes caused by data collection, processing, output and other links, as well as the impact of controlled, malicious application, abuse, misuse and other propagation on personal privacy, social stability, national security and international order. From the perspective of both security issues inherent to AIGC and those caused by its application, a multi-party collaborative regulatory strategy is proposed to safeguard the innovative development of AIGC technology, provide theoretical support for the healthy and standardized development of related industries, and help with economic and social transformation and development.

articleTitle: The Characteristics, Relationships and Challenges of Metaverse, Web 3.0 and AIGC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the growing spiritual needs of people, new generations of digital technologies, such as the Internet of Things, computational power network, artificial intelligence, human-computer interactions, blockchain, digital twins, are continuously evolving and innovating. These technologies are changing people's way of life and production, as well as the economic and social forms that support it. The merging and innovation of digital technology and human society, and humans are moving from the information-physical system CPS (Cyber-Physical Systems) to the human-machine-integrated society-level information-physical system CPHS (Cyber-Physical & Human Systems) towards the metaverse. Meanwhile, the continuous iteration and innovation of Internet is also moving from traditional Internet platform models to Web3.0 with digital production, digital consumption, and new virtual spaces in three dimensions as the main economic and social forms based on blockchain technology. In the metaverse and Web3.0, artificial intelligence-generated content (AIGC) plays a powerful and productive tool role, AIGC being not only a production tool for the metaverse and Web3.0, but also a new paradigm for artificial intelligence development. This paper analyzes the origin of the metaverse, the motivations behind the development of Web3.0, and the new model of AIGC, detailed discussions of the technical systems and mutual relations of metaverse and Web3.0, and finally discusses the development and challenges of metaverse and Web3.0 and AIGC.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Management Information Business and Information System Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The emergency command and dispatch business work has the characteristics of urgency, diversity, complexity and uncertainty. In order to improve the corresponding efficiency of emergency command and dispatch, strengthen the application level of professional knowledge, and connect multi-level information channels, it is necessary to build an emergency management intelligence system. Emergency management intelligence business is mainly composed of information collection, analysis, judgment and presentation. Based on the characteristics of emergency management intelligence business, this paper proposes an overall framework of emergency management intelligence system with theoretical research as the brain, mechanism construction as the core, channel development as the driving force, tool construction as the starting point and technology application as the assessment index. At the same time, it puts forward the construction plan of emergency management information system, and suggests that emergency management departments should make full use of information technology to establish a perfect information collection, analysis, processing and transmission mechanism, improve the timeliness and accuracy of information, and provide reliable support for emergency decision-making.

articleTitle: A Study on the Work Mode of Spacecraft Flight Control from the Perspective of the Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: At present, the work of spacecraft flight control is in the downstream stage of the whole mission chain, and the flight control work mode cannot adapt to the subsequent space missions. In response to these limitations, a conceptual design of a work mode for space flight control from the metaverse’ s perspective is proposed. Model-based systems engineering (MBSE) is adopted as the basic methodology for constructing the flight control metaverse. A common flight control infrastructure is proposed as the foundation for mission system development. A flight control metaverse architecture that targets missions throughout the flight control process is built with extensive applications of AI technology. A new flight control work mode and a mission system work mode are designed to bring about systemic innovation in the flight control work mode. The former work mode features a model-based design of flight control schemes, agile and automatic implementation of mission systems, integrated flight control mission implementation, and parallel operation in physical and virtual spaces. The latter work mode comes with intelligent control, flexible deployment, and autonomous operation capabilities. The flight control metaverse presents a new mode of working space for flight control. The new flight control work mode that builds on the flight control metaverse can be used as a technical reference for the continuous innovation and improvement of subsequent flight control practices.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Test Case Generation Technology and Fuzzing Framework for Power System Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper carries out the research on the fuzzing framework for power system terminals, analyzes the security status and safety protection requirements of business terminals in each link of the power system, builds test case libraries for different types of terminals, and studies the fuzzing framework for power system terminals. Firstly, this paper analyzes the current security situation and safety protection requirements for the business terminals of each link of the power system. From the perspective of network attack and defense, this paper analyzes the influence of power terminal vulnerability attack on the safe and stable operation of power grid. Secondly, the automatic test case generation technology for power system terminal is studied. For unstructured test cases, an automatic test case generation technology based on variation is proposed, and deterministic and random strategies are introduced to improve the diversity of test case generation. For structured test cases, an automatic test case generation technology based on generation is proposed, which can generate test cases quickly through grammar parsing. According to the terminal type and input object, the initial seed library is constructed, a large number of structured and unstructured test cases are generated, and the test case library for power terminal is constructed. Finally, the fuzzing framework for power system terminal is studied. The basic fuzz testing process is summarized from the following aspects: target identification, input vector determination, test case generation, program execution, anomaly monitoring, vulnerability analysis and evaluation, etc. A fuzzing framework for power system terminals is proposed, including test case generator, target program execution engine, monitor, vulnerability detector and vulnerability filter components, to provide a unified test environment for all business terminals, realize efficient and rapid vulnerability mining, and form the active defense capability of power Internet of Things terminals.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzz Testing Optimization Technology for Power Internet of Things Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, the fuzz testing optimization technology for power Internet of Things protocol is studied to improve the accuracy of vulnerability detection for power Internet of Things protocol. The automatic message generation technology of electric Internet of Things protocol based on symbol execution is proposed to solve the adaptation problem and path explosion problem of network protocol symbol execution. By adopting different search strategies and solving optimization to generate the initial seed of protocol message efficiently and with high quality, the preparation cost of fuzz testing is greatly reduced. A fuzz testing technique based on multi-party cooperation is proposed to analyze the execution flow of program blocks caused by message exchange between multiple programs. By designing a new coverage model considering program interaction, the collaborative interaction between different participants of the protocol is combined into coverage calculation, which reflects the overall execution process of complex protocol. We focus on the fuzz testing optimization technology for electric Internet of Things protocol. A fuzz testing optimization technique based on protocol state is proposed to monitor the changes of key state variables in protocol implementation. A new seed scheduling and change algorithm is designed for state change sequence, and a multi-party coordination scenario is combined to guide protocol fuzz testing. A fuzz testing optimization technique based on seed grouping is proposed. In view of the large differences in the seeds of power Internet of Things protocol messages, an efficient seed and execution path similarity calculation method, seed grouping method and a variety of fuzz testing optimization algorithms based on grouping are proposed to group seeds online. At the same time, the fuzz testing is optimized according to the characteristics of each class.

articleTitle: Security Enhancement Technology for Power Internet of Things Protocol and Vulnerability Mining of Edge Devices Based on Fuzz Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to solve the security problems such as the lack of secure key management in the electric Internet of Things protocol, this paper studies the security enhancement technology of electric Internet of Things protocol based on lightweight cryptography technology and new trusted technology. A key exchange scheme based on lightweight cryptography technology is proposed to adapt to the resource-limited scenario of the Internet of Things. To protect keys and data on restricted devices and remote servers, explore lightweight cryptography and new trusted technologies. Performs cryptographic operations without exposing the private key and is resistant to tampering and probing attacks. To realize end-to-end communication and key management between Internet of Things devices and remote servers. At the same time, based on the fuzz testing technology, the unknown vulnerability mining technology of the edge device protocol of the electric Internet of Things is carried out. Firstly, the fuzz testing case intelligent optimization method is studied, and the test case set is reduced based on artificial intelligence algorithms such as genetic algorithm, protocol state machine and stain algorithm, so as to improve the test efficiency. Then, the unknown vulnerability discovery method based on state monitoring is studied, and the test case can be judged whether abnormal occurs by monitoring the state of returned data packets of the tested object, so as to determine whether there are vulnerabilities. Finally, the method of vulnerability intelligent location based on automatic location analysis is studied to accurately locate the test cases that cause vulnerability.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Fuzz Testing Technology for Power Internet of Things Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For many power terminal devices, firmware binary code can be extracted directly from the device by different methods. And the binary firmware program security test, so as to find the Internet of Things terminal device security vulnerabilities. In this paper, the intelligent fuzz testing technology for power Internet of Things terminal is studied. Firstly, the basic framework of binary dynamic piling is studied, and the bottleneck of the existing framework is analyzed. In order to improve the performance of firmware program in dynamic pile driving environment, a dynamic simulation and dynamic pile driving framework combining user level simulation and system level simulation are proposed. Based on this framework, the pile driving method oriented to program coverage and the pile driving method oriented to program vulnerability guidance are studied respectively, which provides support for cross-platform fuzz testing. Secondly, dynamic stain analysis techniques are studied from both offline and online aspects. The advantage of offline dynamic smudge analysis is that it can fine-grained how data is propagated in memory during program execution, and can assist in the generation of initial test seeds. The advantage of online dynamic blot analysis is that it does not affect the performance of simulation test, and can dynamically infer the relationship between input bytes and constraints, so as to guide fuzz testing to carry out targeted variation. Finally, the intelligent prediction model of program vulnerability points is studied to intelligently locate potential defects in binary firmware programs. In order to solve these potential defects, the fuzz testing based on program coverage and potential vulnerability guidance is used, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize.

articleTitle: Survey of Evaluation Methods and Metrics for Face Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Face clustering is one of the basic problems in the field of image processing. In recent years, face clustering technology was widely used. Mostly researchers focus on algorithm optimization, while it should be noted that evaluation methods are the standard of algorithms. How to evaluate the quality of face clustering rapidly and efficiently has academic research significance and practical application value. In this paper, evaluation methods of face clustering are divided into three kinds: accuracy, relevance and performance measures. The main work in this paper includes the following: (1) presenting a short review of face clustering and traditional classification of evaluation methods; (2) after exploring several main databases, summarizing publications and presenting a statistic result; (3)analyzing and comparing evaluating methods of face clustering, and discussing the suitable situations of measures. Finally, the expected research work on face clustering effect assessment is summarized and prospected. In the future, it is still needed to be in-depth study on systematic methods in this field.

articleTitle: Positioning Interference Mitigation Method Based on LSTM Network and Robust Cubature Kalman Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Anti-jamming receivers are an important research direction in navigation and location services. An LSTM-MMCKF predictor for mitigating localization interference is proposed by further improving the system performance through pre-processing of interference signals. The proposed scheme in this paper avoids the long-term dependence plague caused by RNN, and uses the memory cells unique to LSTM to learn the interference information contained in future data, and uses it in subsequent processing to obtain the underlying time series of long and short interference signals. CKF has better estimation performance in high-dimensional systems, while introducing M-M robust estimation to solve the challenge of contamination of measurements and predicted states by non-Gaussian noise. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the mean square prediction error (MSPE) and improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and reduce the influence of interference on the localization process.

articleTitle: Research on Fuzz Testing Framework for Power Internet of Things Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE 13th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the fuzz testing framework for electric Internet of things protocol and analyze the characteristics of different electric Internet of thing protocols. By making full use of the existing information, a new seed scheduling and change algorithm was designed based on the feature and combined with the protocol state, the protocol multi-party collaborative interaction mode and the seed grouping, and the fuzz testing process was redesigned. A fuzz testing framework based on the protocol characteristics of electric Internet of Things is proposed by combining the tools of symbol execution, Markov chain, genetic algorithm and machine learning. It can solve the problems of too much preparation and low testing efficiency in the fuzz testing of the existing electric Internet of Things protocols. Finally, the fuzz test framework for power system terminal is studied. The basic process of fuzz testing is introduced in detail from the aspects of target identification, input vector determination, test case generation, program execution, anomaly monitoring, vulnerability analysis and evaluation. A fuzz testing framework for power system terminal is proposed, which includes test case generator, target program execution engine, monitor, vulnerability detector and vulnerability filter. It can provide a unified testing environment for all business terminals, realize efficient and rapid vulnerability mining, form the active defense capability of terminals, and avoid the operation of Internet of Things terminals with diseases.
